'''DK-9''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was tasked with delivering a shipment of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] from [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] to [[Gizmel Gam]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. DK-9's ship was damaged and crash-landed on [[Savrip Island]], and the individual Gam sent to retrieve the shipment ordered the droid to destroy it upon learning that it was spice.
